description: Read-only SuppCo stack facts with a deterministic, provenance-bearing regimen snapshot export.

tools.name: schedule_show
tools.description: Read the upstream schedule object, then publicly emit {data: ProviderSchedule, provenance: Observation} for one ISO calendar date. Required: date. Returns the ProviderSchedule.

params.name: date
params.description: ISO calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

tools.name: stack_nutrients
tools.description: Read upstream products[].ingredients, then publicly emit {data: StackNutrient[], provenance: Observation} with product-bound components and immediate parent/component relationships. This is not an exposure total. Returns array of StackNutrient.

tools.name: stack_products
tools.description: Read the upstream products array, then publicly emit {data: StackProduct[], provenance: Observation} with only the minimum product identity and label fields. Returns array of StackProduct.
